title: Senior Full-Stack / AI Engineer
headline: Python, FastAPI, React, RAG & LLMs
summary: Senior Full-Stack Engineer with 7+ years of experience designing and building production-grade applications using Python, FastAPI, Django, React, Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL and AWS.
summaryDetail: I own features end-to-end: scalable backend systems and APIs, RBAC/IAM with Keycloak, optimized database workloads, and LLM/RAG capabilities inside enterprise applications. Today I lead modules, mentor developers, review code and work directly with clients to turn business requirements into technical solutions.

story.lead: From a Python intern to leading AI products for international clients.
paragraphs: I started in December 2019 as a software developer intern, learning Python and backend fundamentals on a live enterprise data labeling tool. In June 2020 I joined full-time as a Python developer, building Flask and Django APIs, PostgreSQL data models and Keycloak authentication. I then moved into the frontend too, and finished as the top contributor out of 75 developers.
In 2023 my role grew past code. I started working directly with US and UK clients, gathering requirements, estimating effort, assigning tasks and reviewing code, while still building features myself.

Since January 2024 I have been a senior full-stack and AI engineer and technical lead. I build LLM products with RAG, embeddings and multi-agent workflows, make the architecture calls, and mentor developers through delivery. Alongside my full-time role, I take on part-time freelance work: an agentic no-code platform, Redshift reporting pipelines and an operations platform.
story.quote: Own the problem end-to-end: from the first commit to the release, and the people in between.

achievements: First rank in the Integrated MCA degree; awarded the Mahendra Govind Gold Medal by Uka Tarsadia University.
Recognized as Best Student of the 5-year Integrated MCA programme (batch year 2016–2017).
First rank at intercollegiate competitions Impetus 2018 (Byte-coder) and Impetus 2017 (Net Rising).
